members.name: Richard Sterling
members.title: Founding Partner
members.bio: Richard Sterling founded the firm in 1998 with a vision of providing sophisticated legal counsel with a personal touch. With over 30 years of experience, he has advised on transactions totaling more than $10 billion in value.

members.name: Elizabeth Chen
members.title: Managing Partner
members.bio: Elizabeth Chen leads the firm's litigation practice and serves as Managing Partner. A formidable trial attorney, she has secured landmark victories in federal and state courts across the country.

members.name: Marcus Thompson
members.title: Partner
members.bio: Marcus Thompson advises high-net-worth individuals and families on complex estate planning and wealth preservation strategies. His thoughtful approach has made him a trusted advisor to generations of clients.

members.name: Sarah Mitchell
members.title: Partner
members.bio: Sarah Mitchell represents developers, investors, and lenders in sophisticated commercial real estate transactions. Her deep market knowledge and attention to detail ensure seamless closings.

members.name: David Patel
members.title: Partner
members.bio: David Patel counsels employers on all aspects of the employment relationship. His practical approach helps clients navigate complex workplace issues while minimizing risk.

members.name: Jennifer Wu
members.title: Partner
members.bio: Jennifer Wu helps technology companies and creative enterprises protect their innovations. Her technical background in computer science informs her strategic approach to IP matters.
